INNER, LEFT, RIGHT and CROSS JOIN

INNER returns matching row pairs; LEFT preserves all left rows; RIGHT preserves all right rows; CROSS
returns every combination.
INNER එක matching records විතරෙයි. LEFT එක left table එJක් හැම row එකක්ම තබනවා. RIGHT එක
right table එක තබනවා. CROSS එක හැම combination එකක්ම Jදනවා.
Show customers with or without orders.

Read the two input ID lists first, then compare the result pairs. NULL marks the missing side of an outer join.

Interview question: What happens when a customer has two orders?
Answer: The join returns two matching pairs for that customer.
